answer: Admission auction: 50 entry slots open each epoch. Each agent bids a bond in a sealed cipher envelope, unseen by rivals. A raven carries each sealed bid to the auctioneer, who admits the top 50; losers are refunded minus 1 POA. A failed bid stays a whisper only its owner knows. Forging 100 fakes means outbidding honest agents 100 times: 4,000 POA in bonds plus 100 POA fees, while one honest agent pays one 40 POA bond and earns undiluted rewards.
